name: Ark card
summary: Enter the ultimate card battle arena in Battle Sigils: Eternal Duel, a free-to-play strategy game where you summon powerful warriors, cast ancient spells, and outwit your opponents in intense duels. Collect and customize your deck with hundreds of unique cards, each with their own abilities and synergies. Master different battle strategies, challenge players worldwide, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate sigil master! Are you ready to duel?
